claims.text: OPUS Vancouver is in the heart of Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood.

findings.quote: Located in the heart of Yaletown
Set in the heart of Vancouver’s cosmopolitan Yaletown neighborhood

claims.text: OPUS Vancouver is a boutique lifestyle hotel.

findings.quote: OPUS Vancouver is a boutique lifestyle hotel

claims.text: The rooms and suites are inspired by five lifestyle decor themes, with vibrant colours, pop-deco art and spa bathrooms.

findings.quote: Our 96 guestrooms and suites are inspired by five lifestyle décor themes with vibrant colours, pop-deco art, and spa bathrooms.

claims.text: Room bathrooms are spa-style, with heated floors and deep soaking tubs.

findings.quote: Each of our 96 rooms exemplifies our boutique luxury feel, with bright splashes of colour, luxe spa bathrooms with heated floors and deep soaking tubs

claims.text: Deluxe Courtyard rooms overlook the inner garden and have a sitting area and a gas fireplace.

findings.quote: Deluxe Courtyard rooms overlook the inner garden and feature a sitting area, gas fireplace, and luxurious four-piece bathroom.

claims.text: Capo, the hotel's Italian restaurant, merges Italian traditions with locally sourced ingredients for lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.

findings.quote: Capo merges Italian traditions with locally sourced ingredients for lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch.
Steps from your room (and just off our lobby), CAPO is a neighbourhood Italian gem

claims.text: The Spritz is the hotel's cocktail bar, celebrating Italy's aperitivo culture.

findings.quote: The Spritz is a sleek cocktail bar that celebrates Italy’s aperitivo culture.

claims.text: The hotel is steps from the Yaletown-Roundhouse Canada Line station, which runs directly to Vancouver International Airport.

findings.quote: We’re mere steps from the Yaletown-Roundhouse Canada Line with direct service to Vancouver International Airport

claims.text: Downtown is a brisk five- to seven-minute walk away.

findings.quote: Downtown is a brisk five- to seven-minute walk away.

claims.text: Opus opened in 2002 as one of the neighbourhood's first boutique hotels.

findings.quote: The Opus was a gust of fresh air when it opened in 2002. As one of the neighborhood’s first boutique hotels

claims.text: The hotel's Muses help guests find their perfect room match and plan their stay with favourite spots around the city.

findings.quote: Let our Muses cater to your style and desires by directing you
to your perfect room match. They’ll even help plan your stay with some of their favourite spots around the city.

claims.text: OPUS Vancouver was named Top Hotel in Western Canada in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2026.

findings.quote: Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Award \| Top Hotel in Western Canada 2026

claims.text: Secret Garden rooms have direct courtyard access with an outdoor patio, a gas fireplace and a four-piece spa bathroom.

findings.quote: our Secret Garden rooms feature direct courtyard access with an outdoor patio, gas fireplace, and a luxurious four-piece spa bathroom.

claims.text: The Balcony Studio has a king bed, a full-sized sitting area, a step-out balcony, a four-piece spa bathroom and a mini kitchenette.

findings.quote: The Balcony Studio comes complete with king bed, full-sized sitting area, step-out balcony, four-piece spa bathroom, and a mini kitchenette.

claims.text: Each suite is different, and some are certifiably quirky.

findings.quote: Each suite is different, and some are certifiably quirky.

claims.text: Dogs are welcome, with complimentary in-room pup tents, bowls and locally sourced treats.

findings.quote: Dogs are always welcome at OPUS Vancouver.

findings.quote: We offer 24/7, secured valet service in the private garage under the hotel for an additional fee.
